L1 Fish Market lift out of service
infoLinks.content:
At Fish Market Light Rail Lift between Miller St and the Light Rail stop is temporarily out of service. The lift at Fish Market light rail stop on the L1 Dulwich Hill Line is temporarily of service until further notice. For your safety, do not use even if doors open. Alternative access Use the stairs, if able to Or use the opposite accessible entry/exit ramp via Bank Street.
